The students took 3x online tests hosted via blackboard. They are MCQ style, but not all questions are MCQs, e.g. there are fill in the blank questions, True/False questions, run an analysis and then report the correct values. 



























The test links are available for 48 hours, and they can choose when to take the test in that timeframe. They get 1 hour to complete the test.
info_other1: The online tests make up what's called their 'Portfolio Mark'. This is the average of the three assessments. This portfolio mark then counts for 40% of their module mark.
tasks_other2: The students take part in group seminars where they work on a research project designed by the students and the seminar supervisor. The coursework component (lab report) is based on the project they do in their seminar group. In addition they make a scientific poster based on their project. This is a group effort, and a group assessment. In addition to making the poster, they also present it to their markers (two members of staff). This is normally done at a poster conference, but was done online via Teams the year this cohort did it. They have to divide the presentation up amongst group members and answer questions from their markers.
date_other2: Poster submission: 24/05/2021, Poster presentation: 26/05/2021-27/05/2021 (they were assigned a one hour slot on one of these two days).

The students took 3x online tests hosted via blackboard. They are MCQ style, but not all questions are MCQs, e.g. there are fill in the blank questions, True/False questions, run an analysis and then report the correct values. 



























The test links are available for 48 hours, and they can choose when to take the test in that timeframe. They get 1 hour to complete the test.
info_other1: The online tests make up what's called their 'Portfolio Mark'. This is the average of the three assessments. This portfolio mark then counts for 40% of their module mark.
tasks_other2: The students take part in group seminars where they work on a research project designed by the students and the seminar supervisor. The coursework component (lab report) is based on the project they do in their seminar group. In addition they make a scientific poster based on their project. This is a group effort, and a group assessment. In addition to making the poster, they also present it to their markers (two members of staff). This is normally done at a poster conference, but was done online via Teams the year this cohort did it. They have to divide the presentation up amongst group members and answer questions from their markers.
